name: Xiangxian Shrine documentary sources

museum.facts: 两祠以戟门为中心左右对称，各三楹，中间开门，东西各长8.8米，南北宽6.6米，高6.5米；1998年修葺
museum.exact_excerpt: 分别位于戟门东西两侧，以戟门为中心，左右对称，各三楹，中间开门，东西各长8.8米，南北宽6.6米，高6.5米。
museum.repair_excerpt: 1998年，上海市文物管理委员会拨款对两祠进行了修葺。

official_location.title: 美轮美奂的崇明学宫
official_location.exact_excerpt: 其东侧为名宦祠，西侧为乡贤祠
official_location.interpretation: 名宦祠在戟门东侧，乡贤祠在戟门西侧；文字相对位置不构成单栋地理配准。

individual_photo_status: No individually captioned recent Minghuan/Xiangxian elevations located in this bounded search. Roof types, windows, hidden sides and plan endpoints remain unresolved. Do not treat generic or mirrored houses as observed.

aerial_exclusion.pixel_frame: 677 × 478 pixels; boxes approximate visual localization, not surveyed control points

rejected_candidate_boxes.reason: Farther western architectural axis. The 1881 map places 忠义孝悌祠 farther west of the smaller 乡贤祠 directly beside Ji Gate; a modern article records reconstruction of the west axis in 2016. This outer building cannot safely be identified as Xiangxian Shrine.
Eastern 儒学 axis, aligned with southern 儒学大门 and northern 明伦堂. Historically 仪门 occupies this axis. This outer building cannot safely be identified as Minghuan Shrine.

aerial_exclusion.joint_row_reason: Central horizontal row immediately south of the Dacheng forecourt and north of Pan Pool. The 1881 map places Ji Gate and both shrines in one adjacent row. Trees obscure both ends and facades; the continuous dark roof may cover several units. No stable image boundary identifies a specific shrine.
aerial_exclusion.visible_roof_claims: A central roof band and ridge/eave lines are visible for the combined row. Individual shrine corners, hips/gables, roof joints, columns and openings are unresolved.
aerial_exclusion.roof_type_status: Unverified. The 1881 schematic shows a single ridge/eave tier but does not reliably distinguish 硬山, 悬山 or 歇山; the modern aerial is obscured. A gable choice is an explicit model assumption, not an observed roof.
aerial_exclusion.identity_confidence: Named identities and the east/west relation are secure from official text; binding either shrine to a modern image footprint is unresolved.
aerial_exclusion.defensible_candidate_scope: Separate local text-guided volume and three-bay/central-door candidate using the documented 8.8 x 6.6 x 6.5 m. Dimension endpoints, roof shape, side bays, colours, rear and details are stated assumptions; no photographic verification or geographic registration is claimed.

shared_assumption_model.scope: The independent Xiangxian candidate shares the final Minghuan basic geometry parameters, including the assumed base, walls, roof, openings, colours and rear closure. This is an explicit modeling assumption based on shared documentary dimensions and a symmetrical relation around Ji Gate; it is not evidence that the actual shrines have identical roofs, windows, doors or details. No unsupported decoration is added to distinguish the candidates.
